mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.from_user_id, r.to_user_id, r.communication_score, r.match_score, r.speed_score, r.content, r.created_at, u1.nickname AS from_user_nickname, u2.nickname AS to_user_nickname, p.title AS order_product_title FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u1 ON r.from_user_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON r.to_user_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE r.to_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
